question: Does semla actually exist? I want to eat it! -
answer: Semla is a thing. it's a Swedish sweet. There was this period of time four days before Christmas where everybody fasted. it's an old tradition. Before they fasted, they ate the aforementioned "semla". The tradition in Elbaph is the same as the one of that place. I've never tried semla either. I want to eat it!
name: Odamania
